question: Find the area of a trapezium whose parallel sides are 10 cm and 20 cm and non-parallel sides are equal to 10 cm.
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Parallel sides are 10 cm and 20 cm respectively

Non- parallel sides are 10 cm

**FORMULA USED:**

Area of a trapezium = (1)/(2) × ( Sum of parallel sides ) × height 

**CALCULATION:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51dfcc62b380c0fc7b42204625e1831df1df50dd083cabd5168dd20c12d4587e.png] 

Here, we have parallel sides = 10 cm and 20 cm 

Non- parallel sides = 10 cm

We divide the trapezium into 2 triangles i.e. triangleADE and triangle BFC and a rectangle namely ABFE

Base of triangle = 20 -10 /2 = 10/2 = 5 cm

Height of the triangle and rectangle ( h²) = 10² - 5² = 100 - 25 = 75.

⇒ h = sqrt{75} 

⇒ Area of a trapezium = 1/2 × 30 × sqrt{75} = 15 × sqrt{25 times 3} = 15 × 5 × sqrt3 = 75sqrt3 cm² .

**Hence, area of a trapezium is 75sqrt3** **cm² .**
